# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied only to the latest version of the `main` branch.

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Do not open a public issue** to report vulnerabilities.

Report privately through
[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/jaoppb/styx/security/advisories/new).

Please include:

- a description of the vulnerability and its impact;
- steps to reproduce or a proof of concept;
- affected versions or commits.

You will get a reply as soon as the report is reviewed. Please do not disclose the
vulnerability publicly until a fix is available.
